Conservation and distributional consequences of pricing scarce water during droughts
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Using price incentives to allocate scarce resources is a core tenet of economics but may result in unpalatable distributional outcomes. We analyze the efficacy of prices as a means of inducing water conservation during severe drought by studying the introduction of surcharges enacted within existing nonlinear rate structures. Embedding machine learning counterfactual prediction methods within a demand framework to isolate exogenous price variation, we find evidence that households exhibit a significant demand response despite the temporary nature of surcharges. However, further investigation reveals that surcharges alone cannot explain a majority of the conservation observed despite steep price increases. “Budget-based” rates undercut scarcity signals by shielding large users from binding price increases, and surcharges themselves do little to reduce the regressivity of water expenditures. Simpler rate structures can dominate along equity dimensions, and their progressivity can be enhanced via lump-sum transfers within the rate structure.
abstract_zh: 利用价格激励来配置稀缺资源是经济学的核心原则，但可能导致令人难以接受的分配结果。我们通过研究在既有非线性费率结构中实施附加费的情形，分析了价格作为激励手段在严重干旱期间促进节水的效果。我们将机器学习反事实预测方法嵌入需求框架中，以分离出外生的价格变动，发现尽管附加费具有临时性，家庭仍表现出显著的需求反应。然而，进一步的研究表明，尽管价格大幅上涨，仅靠附加费并不能解释所观察到的大部分节水行为。“基于预算”的费率削弱了稀缺信号，因为它使大用户免受具有约束力的价格上涨影响；而附加费本身对降低水费支出的累退性作用甚微。在公平维度上，更简单的费率结构可能更具优势，并且可以通过费率结构内的一次性转移支付来增强其累进性。

title: Valuing nonmarket impacts of climate change on recreation: From reduced form to welfare
Water affordability in the United States
abstract: In the US, the cost of water and wastewater services is rising three‐times faster than inflation. Over the next 20–25 years, required investments in water infrastructure are estimated to exceed $1 trillion, further increasing service costs. Combined with stagnating income levels, especially for poor households, increased costs will likely aggravate water affordability issues. Here, we document the extent of water affordability concerns in the US across income, geography, and race. We find that 10% of households face water affordability concerns, defined as expenditures on essential water and sewer services greater than 4.5% of annual household income. Households in the lowest income decile pay on average 6.8% of their annual income on water and sewer service. Our estimates are based on a large‐scale data set on water and sewer rates matched with Census block‐group‐level socioeconomic characteristics and covering approximately 45% of the US population. We demonstrate that using median household income at the county level drastically understates the extent of the water affordability problem. Additionally, we find that the number of households facing affordability concerns is positively associated with the proportion of black residents and negatively associated with Hispanic residents even after conditioning on prices and poverty levels. Lastly, we show that self‐sufficient water affordability policies that provide a lump‐sum rebate to low‐income households and are paid for by income taxes redistribute the burden borne by low‐income customers with fewer unintended consequences for non‐essential consumption than policies that change marginal incentives for water and sewer consumption.
abstract_zh: 在美国，水和污水处理服务的成本上涨速度是通货膨胀的三倍。未来20至25年，水基础设施所需投资预计将超过1万亿美元，这将进一步推高服务成本。加之收入停滞，尤其是贫困家庭的收入停滞，成本上升很可能加剧水资源负担能力问题。在此，我们记录了美国各收入群体、各地理区域及各种族中水资源负担能力问题的严重程度。我们发现，10%的家庭面临水资源负担问题，其定义为基本水和下水道服务支出超过家庭年收入的4.5%。最低收入十分位的家庭平均将其年收入的6.8%用于水和下水道服务。我们的估计基于一个大规模的水和下水道收费数据集，该数据集与人口普查街区组层面的社会经济特征相匹配，覆盖约45%的美国人口。我们证明，使用县级家庭收入中位数会大大低估水资源负担问题的严重程度。此外，即使在控制了价格和贫困水平之后，我们发现，面临负担问题的家庭数量与黑人居民比例呈正相关，与西班牙裔居民比例呈负相关。最后，我们表明，以所得税为资金来源、向低收入家庭发放一次性返还补贴的自给型水资源负担能力政策，能够在分散低收入用户所承受负担的同时，对非必需消费产生较少的意外后果；相比之下，改变水和下水道消费边际激励的政策则会产生更多意外后果。

title: Do behavioral nudges interact with prevailing economic incentives? Pairing experimental and quasi-experimental evidence from water consumption
venue: Resources for the Future Working Paper
abstract: Behavioral nudges are popular instruments to promote prosocial behavior, particularly in settings with unpriced externalities. Nudges may interact with existing incentives, however, by crowding out intrinsic motivation to conserve or increasing price salience. We investigate the interaction of prices and nudges for water conservation in two experiments in neighboring utilities. First, we layer randomized behavioral treatments on top of price variation driven by lot-size thresholds that exogenously assign marginal prices. Second, we explore whether behavioral treatments affect consumers’ price elasticities. Our findings suggest that nudges do not induce more conservation at higher prices, nor do they increase price sensitivity.
abstract_zh: 行为助推是促进亲社会行为的流行工具，尤其是在存在未定价外部性的情境中。然而，助推可能与现有激励相互作用，方式包括挤出内在节约动机，或提高价格显著性。我们在两个相邻的供水公司中，通过两项实验研究了价格与助推对节水的交互作用。第一，我们在由地块面积门槛外生分配边际价格的价格变化之上，叠加随机化的行为处理。第二，我们探讨了行为处理是否影响消费者的价格弹性。我们的发现表明，助推并不会在较高价格下带来更多节约，也不会增加价格敏感性。

title: Clustered into control: Heterogeneous causal impacts of water infrastructure failure
abstract: We estimate economic impacts from decaying water infrastructure in the United States. Using water main breaks in Washington, DC, and a yearlong panel of hourly traffic speeds, we estimate causal effects of water main failures on traffic congestion. We use k‐means clustering to create clusters of streets that are similar to each other: treated observations are compared to other units in the cluster. We identify heterogeneous treatment effects algorithmically while retaining straightforward standard error calculations. We find strong evidence of heterogeneous treatment effects across clusters but small welfare impacts of water main breaks on traffic patterns overall.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了美国老化的供水基础设施所造成的经济影响。利用华盛顿特区的水管破裂事件，以及一个为期一年的每小时交通速度面板数据，我们估计了供水管道故障对交通拥堵的因果效应。我们使用k均值聚类，将彼此相似的街道组成若干类别：受处理的观测与同一类别中的其他单元进行比较。我们以算法方式识别异质性处理效应，同时保留直观的标准误计算。我们发现，各类别之间存在较强的异质性处理效应证据，但就总体而言，水管破裂对交通模式的福利影响很小。

title: What should we be teaching students about the economics of climate change: Is there a consensus?
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Research on the economics of climate change has advanced drastically in the last 20 years, but how has treatment of climate change evolved in the classroom? Many economics, environmental studies, and public policy departments now offer climate economics and climate policy courses, but it is unclear what topics are covered, what resources are used, and with what knowledge students are expected to walk away. In this paper, we assess what topics are (or should be) taught in climate economics courses, how those topics have shifted over time, and what learning goals are articulated for students. Our assessment is based on a review of common teaching materials, an informal collection of syllabi, and the results from a survey of environmental and resource economists. Overall, there is a reasonable degree of consensus on the key topics for inclusion across survey respondents, although some topics may complement or crowd out those in standard courses in environmental and resource economics. Despite relatively broad consensus on topics, we find that climate economics courses can diverge greatly in practice, perhaps because there is no central teaching resource used across courses. We conclude constructively by proposing a set of learning goals that instructors can draw from and build upon, which we hope will aid in developing shared expectations for what students will learn in a climate economics course.
abstract_zh: 过去20年间，气候变化经济学的研究取得了长足进展，但气候变化在课堂上的讲授方式是如何演变的？如今，许多经济学、环境研究和公共政策系都开设了气候经济学和气候政策课程，但目前尚不清楚涵盖哪些主题、使用哪些资源，以及学生应当掌握哪些知识。在本文中，我们评估了气候经济学课程中（或应当）讲授哪些主题，这些主题如何随时间变化，以及为学生所阐明的学习目标。我们的评估基于对常用教学材料的回顾、非正式收集的教学大纲，以及对环境与资源经济学家的调查结果。总体而言，调查受访者在关键纳入主题上具有相当程度的共识，尽管某些主题可能与环境与资源经济学标准课程中的内容相互补充或相互挤占。尽管在主题上存在较为广泛的共识，我们发现，气候经济学课程在实践中差异很大，这可能是因为各课程之间没有使用统一的中心教学资源。最后，我们提出了一套学习目标，供教师参考并在此基础上进一步发展，我们希望这有助于建立对气候经济学课程学生将学到什么的共同预期。

title: Bicycle infrastructure and traffic congestion: Evidence from DC's Capital Bikeshare
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We explore the impact of bicycle-sharing infrastructure on urban transportation. Accounting for selection bias in a matching framework, we estimate a causal effect of the Capital Bikeshare on traffic congestion in the metropolitan Washington, DC, area. We exploit a unique traffic dataset that is finely defined on a spatial and temporal scale. Our approach examines within-city commuting decisions as opposed to traffic patterns on major thruways. Empirical results suggest that the availability of a bikeshare reduces traffic congestion by 2 to 3% within a neighborhood. We also identify geographic spillovers that may counteract benefits from reductions in local pollution.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了自行车共享基础设施对城市交通的影响。在匹配框架中考虑选择偏误后，我们估计了首都自行车共享（Capital Bikeshare）对华盛顿特区大都会地区交通拥堵的因果效应。我们利用了一个在空间和时间尺度上划分极为精细的独特交通数据集。我们的方法考察的是城市内部的通勤决策，而非主要干道上的交通模式。实证结果表明，自行车共享的可得性可使某一社区内的交通拥堵减少2%至3%。我们还识别出地理溢出效应，这可能抵消局部污染减少带来的收益。

Conservation policies: Who responds to price and who responds to prescription?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The efficiency properties of price and non-price instruments for conservation in environmental policy are well understood. Yet, there is little evidence comparing the effectiveness of these instruments, especially when considering water resource management. We exploit a rich panel of residential water consumption to examine heterogeneous responses to both price and non-price conservation policies during times of drought while controlling for unobservable household characteristics. Our empirical models suggest that the burden of pricing policies fall disproportionately on low-income households and fail to reduce consumption among households who generally are large consumers of water. However, prescriptive policies such as restrictions on outdoor water use result in uniform responses across income classes while simultaneously targeting reductions from households with irrigation systems or historically high consumption.
abstract_zh: 在环境政策中，价格型与非价格型节约工具的效率特性已得到充分理解。然而，比较这些工具有效性的证据很少，尤其是在考虑水资源管理时。我们利用丰富的居民用水消费面板数据，考察了干旱期间居民对价格型和非价格型节约政策的异质性反应，同时控制了不可观测的家庭特征。我们的实证模型表明，定价政策的负担不成比例地落在低收入家庭身上，并且未能减少那些通常是大量用水者的家庭的用水量。然而，诸如限制户外用水等规定性政策，会在各收入阶层中产生一致的反应，同时针对拥有灌溉系统或历史上用水量较高的家庭实现减量。

title: Incentives, green preferences, and private provision of impure public goods
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Pro-environmental preferences are being used increasingly as environmental policy tools. In this paper, I consider the role of heterogeneous green preferences for private provision of environmental goods that have both private and public characteristics. Under different assumptions of information available to a regulator, I characterize equilibrium properties of several mechanisms. I find incentive-compatible Nash equilibria that provide socially optimal public goods provision when the regulator can enforce individual consumption contracts, as well as when reported consumption contracts are supplemented with group penalties. The role of budget balancing is recast as a policy intervention for correcting environmental market failures. Throughout the paper, I ground the exposition with examples of consumer behavior in the context of green electricity programs and goal setting for energy conservation.
abstract_zh: 亲环境偏好正越来越多地被用作环境政策工具。在本文中，我考察了异质性绿色偏好在具有私人和公共特征的环境物品私人供给中的作用。在监管者掌握不同信息的假设下，我刻画了若干机制的均衡性质。我发现，当监管者能够执行个人消费契约时，以及当报告的消费契约辅以群体惩罚时，存在能够提供社会最优公共物品供给的激励相容纳什均衡。预算平衡的作用被重新界定为纠正环境市场失灵的一种政策干预。在全文中，我以绿色电力计划中的消费者行为以及节能目标设定为例，对论述加以说明。
